queries.title: Dwelling units on building permits issued, by income tier and issue year
queries.method: Building Permit and Combination Building Permit approvals in Development approvals issued in 2025, Development approvals issued in 2024, counted once per JOB_ID; approvals with no JOB_ID are counted apart and in no total. A job is counted in the year of its earliest APPROVAL_ISSUE_DATE, so a job whose permits span two issue years is counted in the first. A job with several building permits is counted once, at the largest figure any of its permits records for each tier. Units are summed by income tier (APPROVAL_DU_EXTREMELY_LOW, _VERY_LOW, _LOW, _MODERATE, _ABOVE_MODERATE) as the permits record them; a blank tier is not a zero, and a tier no job in a year records has no total. Density-bonus units (APPROVAL_DU_BONUS) and ADUs (APPROVAL_ADU_TOTAL) are reported apart because the file does not say whether they are inside the tiers; the JADU columns are not read. APPROVAL_DU_NET_CHANGE is blank in the published file and is not read. Discretionary approvals such as Site Development and Coastal Development permits are left out because their units recur on the building permit. No target is applied.
queries.sql:
WITH permits AS (
 SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("job_id" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS job, TRY_CAST(TRIM(CAST("approval_issue_date" AS VARCHAR)) AS DATE) AS issued,
  TRY_CAST(TRIM(CAST("approval_du_extremely_low" AS VARCHAR)) AS DOUBLE) AS extremely_low, TRY_CAST(TRIM(CAST("approval_du_very_low" AS VARCHAR)) AS DOUBLE) AS very_low, TRY_CAST(TRIM(CAST("approval_du_low" AS VARCHAR)) AS DOUBLE) AS low, TRY_CAST(TRIM(CAST("approval_du_moderate" AS VARCHAR)) AS DOUBLE) AS moderate, TRY_CAST(TRIM(CAST("approval_du_above_moderate" AS VARCHAR)) AS DOUBLE) AS above_moderate, TRY_CAST(TRIM(CAST("approval_du_bonus" AS VARCHAR)) AS DOUBLE) AS bonus, TRY_CAST(TRIM(CAST("approval_adu_total" AS VARCHAR)) AS DOUBLE) AS adu
 FROM "analysis_approvals_issued_2025" WHERE TRIM(CAST("approval_type" AS VARCHAR)) IN ('Building Permit', 'Combination Building Permit')
 UNION ALL
 SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("job_id" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS job, TRY_CAST(TRIM(CAST("approval_issue_date" AS VARCHAR)) AS DATE) AS issued,
  TRY_CAST(TRIM(CAST("approval_du_extremely_low" AS VARCHAR)) AS DOUBLE) AS extremely_low, TRY_CAST(TRIM(CAST("approval_du_very_low" AS VARCHAR)) AS DOUBLE) AS very_low, TRY_CAST(TRIM(CAST("approval_du_low" AS VARCHAR)) AS DOUBLE) AS low, TRY_CAST(TRIM(CAST("approval_du_moderate" AS VARCHAR)) AS DOUBLE) AS moderate, TRY_CAST(TRIM(CAST("approval_du_above_moderate" AS VARCHAR)) AS DOUBLE) AS above_moderate, TRY_CAST(TRIM(CAST("approval_du_bonus" AS VARCHAR)) AS DOUBLE) AS bonus, TRY_CAST(TRIM(CAST("approval_adu_total" AS VARCHAR)) AS DOUBLE) AS adu
 FROM "analysis_approvals_issued_2024" WHERE TRIM(CAST("approval_type" AS VARCHAR)) IN ('Building Permit', 'Combination Building Permit')
), jobs AS (
 SELECT job, YEAR(MIN(issued)) AS issued_year, COUNT(*) AS permits, MAX(extremely_low) AS extremely_low, MAX(very_low) AS very_low, MAX(low) AS low, MAX(moderate) AS moderate, MAX(above_moderate) AS above_moderate, MAX(bonus) AS bonus, MAX(adu) AS adu
 FROM permits WHERE job IS NOT NULL GROUP BY job
)
SELECT issued_year, COUNT(*) AS jobs, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE extremely_low IS NOT NULL OR very_low IS NOT NULL OR low IS NOT NULL OR moderate IS NOT NULL OR above_moderate IS NOT NULL) AS tiered_jobs,
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE permits > 1) AS multi_permit_jobs, SUM(extremely_low) AS extremely_low, SUM(very_low) AS very_low, SUM(low) AS low, SUM(moderate) AS moderate, SUM(above_moderate) AS above_moderate, SUM(bonus) AS bonus, SUM(adu) AS adu,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM permits WHERE job IS NULL) AS no_job_permits
FROM jobs GROUP BY issued_year ORDER BY issued_year NULLS LAST
